core_research_findings.when_caching_excels: Enterprise repetitive workloads (hit rate 78.4%) and bursty event traffic (hit rate 95.0%) achieve dramatic 15x-20x latency reductions and 75-95% cost savings.
core_research_findings.when_caching_hurts: On unique long-tail workloads (<3% hit rate), exact caching introduces an uncompensated 1.2ms SQLite lookup penalty with zero cost reduction.
core_research_findings.privacy_compliance: On privacy-restricted workloads, zero items are cached, strictly upholding data governance policies.
